prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / stylized-concept.
Asset type: Original transparent cinematic illustration for Previously.'s real iOS welcome screen. Generate ONLY the artwork, no app mockup, no logo or text.
Reference image 1 is the real current welcome UI: keep its near-black, ivory, coral and restrained warm accent character. The user wants this screen to feel cozy and comforting. The current cold graphite product diorama is rejected; do NOT make another plastic miniature or product sculpture.
Primary request: a small inviting nighttime viewing nook painted with the tenderness of an original anime background illustration. A plush deep-charcoal sofa with gently rounded cushions and a casually draped soft oatmeal knit throw, one warm shaded reading lamp, a small mug on a low dark-walnut side table, and a pair of simple slippers. A quiet suggestion of a window with muted night sky behind the sofa. No people or known characters. No television content, posters, logos, names or recognizable fictional setting. A room ready for someone to curl up with their favorite episode.
Mood: restful, sheltered, lived-in, comforting; a soft pool of honey-amber lamplight touches the blanket and cushion. Surroundings fall into graphite shadow. Warmth should come from light and soft textures, not a large beige background. Tiny muted coral detail on a cushion seam or mug.
Style: beautiful hand-painted cinematic environment illustration, soft brushwork, subtle tactile texture, restrained detail, no hard toy-like gloss, no shiny metal or split-flap hardware. NOT photoreal, NOT children's clipart, NOT overly cute mascot art.
Composition: compact low-wide 5:3 composition, slight 3/4 view. Sofa and lamp are the focal points, clear silhouettes and readable at 260 by 156 points. No distant room clutter. The dark room's outer shapes dissolve gently into real transparent alpha; no rectangular tile, circular platform, visible base, border, or opaque wall/backdrop.
Palette: near-black #09090B, charcoal #242428, warm graphite #303034, warm ivory highlights #F4F1EC, subdued honey lamplight, one very small muted coral accent. Keep overall luminance quiet so the app's wordmark and amber Sign in action stay dominant.
Avoid: bright white TV screen, saturated blue or purple, neon, sci-fi, floating film cards, chrome, confetti, spotlight beams, gradient halo outside the nook, text, watermark, known IP. True transparent background.
feedback: User requested cozy and comforting rather than cold product sculpture
